ResearchProjectDef.label: hydroponics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow crops indoors in nutrient basins under artificial sunlight. Unlocks hydroponics basins and sun lamps.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nutrient paste
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn raw food into nutrient paste with a dispenser. Unlocks the nutrient paste dispenser and hoppers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: packaged survival meals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make sealed meals that keep almost forever. Unlocks packaged survival meals.

ResearchProjectDef.label: drug lab
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce drugs at a dedicated lab. Unlocks the drug lab, flake, yayo, wake-up, go-juice, cigarettes and the autobong.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pharmaceuticals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture industrial medicine and preventive drugs. Unlocks medicine and penoxycyline.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hospital care
ResearchProjectDef.description: Equip a proper hospital. Unlocks hospital beds, vitals monitors and sterile tiles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: prosthetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Replace lost limbs and organs with simple mechanical parts. Unlocks simple prosthetics and the cochlear implant.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fertility procedures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Control and assist fertility through surgery. Unlocks the fertility operations.

ResearchProjectDef.label: genetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extract, store, process and assemble genes. Unlocks the gene extractor, gene bank, gene assembler and gene processor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: archogenetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work with archite genes beyond human understanding.

ResearchProjectDef.label: biosculpting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reshape and heal the body in a biosculpter pod, and boost the mind with a neural supercharger. Unlocks the biosculpter pod, its regeneration cycle and the neural supercharger.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deathrest
ResearchProjectDef.description: Support sanguophages through deathrest. Unlocks deathrest caskets and their connected buildings.

ResearchProjectDef.label: concrete
ResearchProjectDef.description: Pour concrete and paved tiles. Unlocks concrete and paved tile floors.

ResearchProjectDef.label: autodoors
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build powered doors that open by themselves. Unlocks the autodoor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heavy bridges
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build bridges strong enough for heavy structures. Unlocks heavy bridges.

ResearchProjectDef.label: piano
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a piano. Unlocks the piano.

ResearchProjectDef.label: television
ResearchProjectDef.description: Watch moving pictures on a tube television. Unlocks the tube television.

ResearchProjectDef.label: flatscreen television
ResearchProjectDef.description: Watch on a large flat screen. Unlocks the flatscreen television.

ResearchProjectDef.label: machining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Machine precise metal parts. Unlocks the machining table.

ResearchProjectDef.label: microelectronics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build and use small electronic circuits. Unlocks sleep accelerators and the electronics that later research builds on.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fabricate components from raw materials. Unlocks the fabrication bench.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fabricate advanced components. Unlocks advanced components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep drilling
ResearchProjectDef.description: Find and drill mineral deposits deep underground or far away. Unlocks the deep drill and the ground-penetrating and long-range mineral scanners.

ResearchProjectDef.label: electricity
ResearchProjectDef.description: Generate electricity and carry it through conduits. Unlocks generators, conduits, lamps, heaters and the electric workbenches.

ResearchProjectDef.label: batteries
ResearchProjectDef.description: Store electricity for later. Unlocks batteries.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced lighting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Light large areas with coloured and flood lights. Unlocks advanced lights.

ResearchProjectDef.label: renewable power
ResearchProjectDef.description: Draw power from the sun and running water. Unlocks solar panels and watermill generators.

ResearchProjectDef.label: geothermal power
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tap the heat of steam vents for power. Unlocks the geothermal generator.

ResearchProjectDef.label: biofuel refining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine plant and animal matter into chemfuel. Unlocks the biofuel refinery.

ResearchProjectDef.label: climate control
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cool rooms with machines and dry out marshy ground. Unlocks coolers and moisture pumps.

ResearchProjectDef.label: firefoam
ResearchProjectDef.description: Smother fires with foam. Unlocks firefoam poppers, firefoam packs and firefoam shells.

ResearchProjectDef.label: toxifier generator
ResearchProjectDef.description: Generate power at the cost of polluting the land. Unlocks the toxifier generator.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wastepack atomizer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Destroy toxic wastepacks completely. Unlocks the wastepack atomizer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gunsmithing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make cartridge firearms. Unlocks the revolver, bolt-action rifle, pump shotgun and incendiary and smoke launchers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: grenades
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make hand-thrown and launched explosives. Unlocks frag, molotov and EMP grenades and the EMP launcher.

ResearchProjectDef.label: blowback operation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make guns that reload themselves from the recoil. Unlocks the autopistol and machine pistol.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gas operation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make guns that cycle on their own propellant gas. Unlocks the chain shotgun, heavy SMG and LMG.

ResearchProjectDef.label: precision rifling
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make accurate long rifles. Unlocks the assault rifle and sniper rifle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: multibarrel weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make rotary-barrel guns. Unlocks the minigun.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gun turrets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build automated turrets and field fortifications. Unlocks mini-turrets, foam turrets, sandbags and barricades.

ResearchProjectDef.label: autocannon turret
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build heavy turrets. Unlocks the autocannon turret.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced turrets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build long-range turrets. Unlocks the uranium slug turret and rocketswarm launcher.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mortars
ResearchProjectDef.description: Shell enemies from afar. Unlocks the mortar and its high-explosive, incendiary, smoke and EMP shells.

ResearchProjectDef.label: IEDs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rig explosives as traps. Unlocks the IED traps.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tox gas
ResearchProjectDef.description: Weaponise toxic gas. Unlocks tox shells, tox packs, the toxbomb launcher and tox grenades.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hunter drones
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build drones that hunt down enemies. Unlocks the hunter drone pack and trap.

ResearchProjectDef.label: flak armour
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make modern protective gear. Unlocks flak vests, jackets and trousers, advanced helmets and gas masks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: combat packs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make utility packs for the battlefield. Unlocks the smokepop pack and gunlink.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jump packs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make packs that launch the wearer through the air. Unlocks the jump pack and locust armour.

ResearchProjectDef.label: basic mechtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control basic-tier mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: standard mechtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control standard-tier mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high mechtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control high-tier mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: transport pods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Launch pods that carry people and goods across the world. Unlocks transport pods and pod launchers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: communications
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reach traders and factions by radio. Unlocks the comms console and orbital trade beacon.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced research
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research with modern equipment. Unlocks the hi-tech research bench and multi-analyzer.
